why_smaller.title: Oklo / OKLO — political proximity meets a bruised share price
why_smaller.selection_evidence: CNBC reported Trump's selection of Chris Wright, identified as both Liberty Energy CEO and an Oklo board member, for Energy secretary.[[n3718]] That supplies a fresh political connection to a nuclear company already pursuing data-centre partnerships, according to Business Wire.[[n4051]] The latest completed stock session preceded the appointment news: OKLO closed at USD 18.00 after a -24.62% session and a -26.44% five-session move (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-15). The attraction is a possible change in the policy backdrop after a severe drawdown, rather than an already observed market response to the selection.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: political proximity meets a bruised share price

why_smaller.title: Bitcoin funds / IBIT — professional portfolios join the conversation
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Reuters reported Millennium, Capula and Tudor adding bitcoin ETFs to their portfolios.[[n3706]] That is an actual institutional participation headline, distinct from inferring purchases from a rising price. IBIT closed at USD 52.13, up +19.32% over five sessions and +33.43% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-15). The retail attraction is that familiar professional names can make an asset feel more established and easier to justify in a portfolio. The disclosure says something about their reported holdings, however, rather than promising that they will continue buying at the next quotation.

why_smaller.title: Applied Digital / APLD — a famous shareholder makes the pitch
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Yahoo Finance reported an Nvidia stake in Applied Digital and a stock rise of more than 5%.[[n3707]] The appeal is validation by a recognised AI leader: a specialised company becomes easier to explain when a familiar name appears beside it. A retail investor can read the investment as a reason to investigate the underlying opportunity. The temptation is to skip that investigation and assume that owning the same company produces the same economics or risk tolerance as another investor. An outside stake can be meaningful without answering every shareholder question.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: a famous shareholder makes the pitch

considered_not_chosen: OKLO severe own-card drawdown plus new weekend Energy-secretary selection gives fresh side; no invented pre-open reaction.
IBIT actual Reuters institutional portfolio evidence materially new.
APLD Nvidia stake and headline price reaction new company catalyst.
